visual.description: Faz 1 (0-3.5s): Dark screen, question text ease-in centered with clock icon spinning below. Faz 2 (3.5-8s): Hard cut to world map globe footage. Faz 3 (8-12s): Hard cut to sharp-dressed white-collar financier. Faz 4 (12s-end): Hard cut to factory worker in developing country.

textOverlay.text: What is one hour of your life worth?

hookConfig.questionText: What is one hour of your life worth?

notes: Hook scene — 4 phases with hard cuts. Phase 1: Question + clock on dark bg. Phase 2: World map footage synced with 'The answer depends... Where you were born.' Phase 3: White-collar financier synced with 'In some countries, an hour of work buys a full meal.' Phase 4: Factory worker synced with 'In others, it barely covers a cup of coffee' and continues until scene end.
